part.text:
Fixed. The segfault happened because `jq`'s literal-number decContext used `ctx->digits = DEC_MAX_DIGITS - 1` (999999998), which lets decNumber store exponents down to `etiny = emin - digits + 1 = -1999999996`. Comparing two numbers computes `rhs->exponent - lhs->exponent`, which can reach ~3×10⁹ and overflow `Int` (int32), causing the out-of-bounds read in `decUnitCompare` (src/decNumber/decNumber.c:6257).

The fix in `src/jv.c:530` (matching upstream) caps the context digits so the exponent difference (and `(Int)D2U(...)` on it) can never overflow:

```c
ctx->digits = MIN(DEC_MAX_DIGITS,
    INT32_MAX - (DECDPUN - 1) - (ctx->emax - ctx->emin - 1));
```

Verified in the container: `3E506760210 < 63E-6855002263` and `[3E506760210, 63E-6855002263] | sort` no longer crash, the `#2825` regression tests in `tests/jq.test` pass, and the full `make check` suite passes (8/8).
